title: Server-side FMB preparation and guided source adoption
changes: Prepare one raw FMB on a configured private Oracle Forms host from the project upload screen.
Preserve the original, both native exports, effective metadata and validated redaction evidence.
Bind preparation to the project owner and selected source version without starting AI processing.
Check preparation status and explicitly add the redacted result to project source history.
Retain uncertain requests without automatic replay or duplicate source publication.
limitations: Server-side preparation must be configured and tested by the operator; a source release does not enable it.
This hosted preparation route accepts one FMB per request; MMB, OLB and PLL require the separate supported preparation route.
The prototype processing profile and trusted converter/browser adapters require explicit operator configuration.
Real-file OPAF-to-APEX import, authenticated runtime and downloadable export acceptance remain pending.
Technical identifiers are retained; redaction receipts are not complete PII certification or processing permission.
APEX generated, technical checks passed and business acceptance remain separate.
Release notes describe software changes, not proof of a successful conversion.
